upstream.description: Search the web and your self-hosted apps using local AI agents.

classification.analysis: Perplexideez is a self-hosted Perplexity-style AI search app (SvelteKit/TypeScript) that answers queries by searching the web through a SearXNG instance, grounds responses with clickable source citations, and generates follow-up questions, backed by Postgres and either Ollama or OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoints. It targets self-hosters who want multi-user support, SSO/OIDC, shareable search links with access control, and Kubernetes/Docker deployment, distinguishing it from other homelab Perplexity clones by that integration and multi-tenancy focus. Development appears stalled since November 2024 with no further commits.

use_cases.title: Self-host a private, citation-grounded AI search assistant
Give a homelab multi-user access to AI web search with SSO
Wire local Ollama models to a SearXNG-backed search UI
Deploy an AI search app via Helm/Kubernetes manifests
